 Java United vs Persib Bandung Today: Live Schedule, Predicted Lineups, and Head-to-Head
 Java United vs Persib Bandung Today: Live Schedule, Predicted Lineups, and Head-to-Head
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Niken Pramudya 
 November 8, 2026, 15:05 WITA · 6 min read 
 Close ad × 
 Advertisement 
 Photo caption: Malut United and Persib Bandung players compete for the ball during a Liga 1 match at Gelora Kie Raha Stadium, Ternate, Friday (5/2/2025). 
 SEMARANG, Aktualita.co -  The match between Java United and Persib Bandung is one of the highlights of the ninth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. Both teams are scheduled to meet at Jatidiri Stadium, Semarang, on Sunday (11/8/2026) evening, with both sides aiming to secure three points. 
 The match, which kicks off at 19:00 WIB (Western Indonesian Time) or 20:00 WITA (Central Indonesian Time), is expected to be intense. Persib arrives with high confidence after securing a spot in the round of 16 of the AFC Champions League Two, while Java United is enjoying a positive run and remains unbeaten in their last five league matches. 
 Advertisement 
 This duel is also an important test for Persib, who are looking to close the gap with the teams at the top of the standings. Conversely, Java United wants to maintain their unbeaten home record this season. 
 The meeting has its own narrative, as several Java United players were once key parts of Persib Bandung's journey, including Ciro Alves, David da Silva, Gustavo Franca, and Frets Butuan. 
 Java United vs Persib Bandung Schedule and Live Broadcast 
 The match between Java United and Persib Bandung will take place on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at Jatidiri Stadium, Semarang. 
 Kick-off is scheduled for 19:00 WIB or 20:00 WITA. The match can be watched via live broadcast on Indosiar and the Vidio streaming service. 
 This match is part of the ninth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. The result will affect both teams' positions in the current standings. 
 Before the match, Persib Bandung sits in fifth place with 16 points from eight matches. Java United is in the middle of the table with 10 points from the same number of matches. 
 Persib needs a win to maintain their chances of competing for the top spot. However, facing Java United at their home ground is no easy task. 
 Java United Is in Positive Form 
 Java United, previously known as Malut United, has shown interesting progress over the last few matches. 
 Fabio Lefundes' team is unbeaten in their last five Super League matches, with a record of three wins and two draws. 
 In their previous league match, Java United managed to defeat Bhayangkara Presisi Lampung FC with a score of 2-0 on October 30, 2026. 
 This positive result extends the momentum for the team nicknamed Laskar Kepodang Emas. They have also recorded three wins and one draw in four home matches this season. 
 Java United coach, Fabio Lefundes, expressed his confidence in his players' ability to face Persib. 
 “I believe 100 percent that Java United has quality players to face a match and a team of Persib Bandung's caliber,” said Lefundes in a press conference on Saturday (11/7/2026). The Brazilian coach does not consider Persib's tight schedule an automatic advantage for his team. According to him, Java United must still demonstrate their best quality of play to face the defending champions. 
 In this match, Ciro Alves and Gustavo Almeida are expected to be key figures in the hosts' efforts to break down Persib's defense. 
 Speed on the wings and the ability to deliver crosses into the penalty area could be Java United's weapons to create opportunities. 
 Persib Bandung Arrives with Momentum from Asian Victory 
 Persib Bandung enters this match after navigating a fairly tight competition schedule. 
 The Maung Bandung squad just defeated Melbourne Victory with a score of 2-1 in Australia on Wednesday (11/4/2026). The victory secured Persib's path to the round of 16 of the 2026/2027 AFC Champions League Two. 
 Previously, Persib also won 4-0 against Isenmulang Kalteng FC in a Super League match on Sunday (11/1/2026). 
 Although they bring positive momentum, player fitness is a concern. The travel from Australia to Indonesia and limited recovery time could potentially influence the coaching staff's decisions in determining the starting lineup. 
 Persib Bandung captain, Marc Klok, emphasized that his team is still chasing maximum results before entering the competition break. 
 “We want to be at the top of the standings and in the top position in any competition,” said Klok ahead of the match. 
 Persib has a number of player options to control the tempo and build attacks. Marc Klok, Thom Haye, and Luciano Guaycochea are options in the midfield, while Luka Menalo, Mariano Peralta, and Uilliam Barros can provide threats in the front line. 
 Finishing effectiveness will be one of the important factors for Persib when facing the hosts' defense, which has been showing improvement. 
 Head to Head Java United vs Persib Bandung 
 Based on the records of their four previous meetings, the rivalry between the two teams is fairly balanced. Java United and Persib Bandung have both collected two wins with no draws. 
 Here are the results of the last four meetings: 
 February 6, 2026: Persib Bandung 2-0 Java United 
 December 14, 2025: Java United 2-0 Persib Bandung 
 May 2, 2025: Java United 1-0 Persib Bandung 
 December 13, 2024: Persib Bandung 2-0 Java United 
 The two Java United victories occurred when the club was still using the name Malut United and was based at Kie Raha Stadium, Ternate. 
 Meanwhile, Persib has always won with a 2-0 score in their two home meetings against the team. 
 This record shows that the home factor has previously provided an advantage for each team. However, this meeting takes place in Semarang following the change in identity and home base of Java United. 
 Predicted Lineups for Java United vs Persib 
 Both teams have the opportunity to use a combination of experienced players and those in the best physical condition. 
 Predicted Java United (4-2-3-1): Cyrus Margono; Riyan Ardiansyah, Gustavo Franca, Cleylton, Yance Sayuri; Vander, Kei Hirose; Lukas Brambilla, Ciro Alves, Yakob Sayuri; Gustavo Almeida. 
 Coach: Fabio Lefundes. 
 Predicted Persib Bandung (4-3-3): Fitrah Maulana; Kakang Rudianto, Patricio Matricardi, Julio Cesar, Ikhwan Tanamal; Luciano Guaycochea, Marc Klok, Gakuto Notsuda; Beckham Putra, Uilliam Barros, Luka Menalo. 
 The Persib coaching staff still has alternatives for rotation, considering the tight schedule of matches they have just gone through. 
 The lineup is still an estimate and may change following official decisions ahead of kick-off. 
 Match Prediction: Persib Must Be Wary of Java United's Attacks 
 The match is expected to run with high intensity from the first minute. Java United has the potential to utilize the support of the spectators to take the initiative in attacking, while Persib has experience in facing important matches. 
 The midfield duel will be one of the deciding factors. The team that can control ball distribution and reduce passing errors will have a chance to get more scoring opportunities. 
 Java United also needs to be wary of Persib's ability to exploit empty spaces when the opponent places too many players forward. 
 On the other hand, Persib must not ignore the threat of the hosts' quick transitions, especially through Ciro Alves and the movement of players from both wings. 
 Looking at recent performances, the chances for both teams to get a positive result are relatively open. Java United has the advantage of playing at home, while Persib arrives with the momentum of consecutive wins. 
 Score prediction : Java United 1-1 Persib Bandung. 
 This score is an estimate based on the condition of both teams before the match, not an official result. 
 The winner of the Java United vs Persib Bandung match will have important momentum to continue the competition in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League after the international break.
